sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 120

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 120:1
items.html: Before the sin, at the beginning of the emergence of BYA from the breaking, the place of the ten Sefirot of Yetzirah was in the four lower [Sefirot] of the ZA of Atzilut and the six upper [Sefirot] of Beriah. And the place of the ten Sefirot of Assiyah was in the four lower [Sefirot] of Beriah and the six upper [Sefirot] of Yetzirah. And after the sin, the ten Sefirot of Yetzirah fell to the place of Assiyah that was before the sin, because the six upper [Sefirot] of Yetzirah fell to the place of the six lower [Sefirot] of Assiyah before the sin, and the four lower [Sefirot] of Yetzirah fell lower, because they fell to the dwelling place of the Klipot. (Item 48).
